title: Nutty Shaggy Syrian Hazelnut Pilaf
description: A peppery, show-off Syrian dish featuring shelled hazelnuts, this pilaf is a hearty and flavorful meal option, pressure-cooked to perfection in an agave-leaf vessel and suitable for low-glycemic diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the agave-leaf vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the chopped hazelnuts and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the brown rice, water, black pepper, salt, and garlic powder to the vessel.
Stir the mixture well to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the vessel.
Pressure-cook the pilaf for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the vessel from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
